scale: Sheets are @2x with frames left to right. 1x/ holds the same files at world px. All coordinates are px from the cell top-left (anchors) or from the anchor (offsets), screen y down.
camera: Same 3/4 map camera as towers-aim-v1 (ground circles squash to about 0.58 vertically).

drone.facing: east (screen right). Mirror horizontally for west. For other headings rotate about the anchor, or keep it unrotated and only mirror (see README).
drone.anchorMeaning: centre of the drone body. Draw it at (x, groundY - altitude).
drone.dropOffsetMeaning: bomb release point (belly, under the camera pod), measured from the drone anchor. Negate x if the drone is mirrored.

droneShadow.anchorMeaning: ground point straight under the drone: (x + dropOffset.x, groundY). Ground layer.

bomb.anchorMeaning: centre of the bomb. Spawn with anchor = drone drop point + spawnOffset (the bomb top then sits on the release point).
bomb.note: Frame 1 has the amber arming light on, and the two frames rock ±6°. Explode when the nose (anchor + noseOffset) reaches groundY.

bombShadow.note: At the impact point on the ground layer, scale from 0.4 to 1.0 and alpha from 0.45 to 1.0 over the fall.

explosion.note: Frames: 0 flash, 1 fireball and shockwave (apply damage or slow here; shake the camera), 2 fireball in smoke, 3–4 the dust ring reaches the full radius, 5–7 smoke rises and fades. No gore. To match another radius, scale the sprite by radiusWorld / 92 about the anchor.

scorch.note: Ground decal centred on the impact. Frame 0 has glowing embers (show it for about 1 s), and frame 1 is plain. Fade with alpha (see the README timeline). Scale it with the explosion if the radius changes.

events: drone enters, flying toward the target
drone drop point is over the target: spawn the bomb; the drone keeps flying
bomb nose reaches the ground: explosion frame 0, scorch(embers) on frame 1
explosion frame 1: apply the Drone Strike effect, shake the camera for about 0.15 s
scorch switches to the plain frame
scorch fades to 0 over 1 s (5 s zone, 7.5 s with the long upgrade)
